__typename.description: GraphQL type name of this object.

supplyQuantity.description: Quantity to be supplied in the next shipment, only used in response requisition

suggestedQuantity.description: Calculated quantity When months_of_stock < requisition.min_months_of_stock, calculated = average_monthly_consumption * requisition.max_months_of_stock - months_of_stock

ancillaryParents.description: Items that have this line's item configured as an ancillary. Empty when the line is not an ancillary of anything. Used by the UI to flag ancillary lines and surface their parents in a popover. Batched per request via dataloader so a 200-line requisition issues two queries (link rows + parent items), not 400.

outboundShipmentLines.description: OutboundShipment lines linked to requisitions line

inboundShipmentLines.description: InboundShipment lines linked to requisitions line

itemStats.description: For request requisition: snapshot stats (when requisition was created) For response requisition current item stats

remainingQuantityToSupply.description: Quantity remaining to supply supplyQuantity minus all (including unallocated) linked invoice lines numberOfPacks * packSize Only available in response requisition, request requisition returns 0

alreadyIssued.description: Quantity already issued in outbound shipments

forecastMethod.description: Where the line's monthly demand comes from

forecastMonthlyConsumption.description: The line's monthly demand in units: what its suggested quantity, months of stock and target stock work from, whatever its forecast method

forecastBreakdown.description: The inputs and steps behind the line's monthly demand

forecastMethodOptions.description: Every forecast method, an unavailable one with its reason. Empty on a response requisition's line, whose forecast is the customer's.

targetStock.description: The requisition's target months × the line's monthly demand
